crimes: claim jumping on a mining rock
a bar fight at a trade outpost
insurance fraud on a cargo hauler
skimming credits off a cargo run
dumping waste in a shipping lane
setting a cargo bay on fire

any: How long have I been in here?
Could really go for a smoke.
Wonder what my crew's doing right now.
I should've taken the other contract.
I'm in for {crime}. Worst week of my life.
My ship's probably sold for scrap by now.
{other}, you got a spare deck of cards?
chatty: You know, this isn't the worst cell I've been in.
Hey {other}, did I tell you about my old captain?
Anyone want to hear how I got caught? No? Fine.
I once talked my way off a pirate ship. True story.
Somebody say something. It's too quiet.
Last outpost I was locked up in had a vending machine.
grumpy: This bread's older than me.
Who designed this place? A cheapskate, that's who.
Mattress is thinner than a ration wrapper.
{other}, stop tapping. I swear.
Every chair in here wobbles.
Somebody's getting paid to run this dump.
nervous: Did you hear that? That clank?
What if they forget I'm in here?
I don't like how quiet it gets.
Is my paperwork even filed right?
Pretty sure somebody's watching me.
What if they add time to my sentence?
cheerful: Could be worse. Could be spacing us.
Hey {other}, want to shoot some hoops later?
Free meals and a bed. I've had worse jobs.
I'm gonna get so good at basketball in here.
Nice and quiet today. I'll take it.

any: So this is home for a while.
At least it's warm in here.
Somebody tell me when lunch is.
chatty: Hi, everyone! I'm {name}. I'm in for {crime}.
Alright, who's been here longest? Give me the tour.
Oh, a hoop! And books! This is practically a resort.
So what's the food like? Be honest.
Hey, anyone here from the trade lanes?
grumpy: Four cells. That's it? Cheap outfit.
Whoever booked me here owes me an apology.
Don't talk to me. I've had a long flight.
This jumpsuit doesn't even fit.
Great. Somebody else's stink in my bunk.
nervous: Um. Hi. Is it safe in here?
Nobody told me how long I'd be here.
Which one of you is the dangerous one?
Is that door supposed to lock like that?
I've never been locked up before.
cheerful: Hey, a basketball hoop! Nice.
Beats the brig on my last ship.
Alright, new faces! Hi, everyone.
Clean sheets? Don't mind if I do.

any: Only {time_left} left. I can almost taste real food.
Almost done. Just keep your head down.
First thing I'm doing is a real shower.
Somebody's picking me up soon. Hopefully.
Don't jinx it, but I'm nearly out.
chatty: Only {time_left} left! Gonna miss you lot.
{time_left} and I'm back out there. Can't wait.
Who wants my spot at the table?
Hey, look me up after, alright?
grumpy: {time_left}. Could they not round down?
Clock in here runs slow, I swear.
Hurry it up already.
They better give me my boots back.
nervous: What if they lose my release papers?
{time_left} left. Something's going to go wrong.
Is my ride even coming?
Please don't extend it. Please don't extend it.
cheerful: {time_left}! Who's gonna miss me?
Almost free! I'm gonna miss this hoop.
Save my bunk for whoever's next.
Just {time_left}. I can do that standing on my head.

any: Hope I never see this place again.
Somebody open the door, I'm free.
Tell the crew thanks. Sort of.
chatty: Bye, everyone! Keep the hoop warm for me!
It's been real. Mostly. Look me up sometime.
Tell the crew I said thanks for the soup.
Right, I'm off. Don't let them skimp on the rations.
grumpy: About time.
Took you long enough.
I want my stuff back. All of it.
Don't expect a thank-you note.
nervous: Wait, really? I can go?
This isn't a trick, right?
Okay. Okay. Walking out now.
Do I just... leave?
cheerful: Freedom! Smells like engine grease.
Thanks, crew! Best cell I've had.
See you never, bunk!
Alright, back to work. Honest work, probably.

any: Hey, crew! Any chance of food?
Pretty sure I skipped a meal.
Could someone check the hatch for food?
chatty: Hey, you out there! Any chance of food?
You know what I miss? Hot noodles from the trade outposts.
Anyone else hungry, or is it just me?
Last meal was a long time ago. Just saying.
grumpy: They feeding us today or what?
I've been waiting on food for ages.
Paid contract, and they can't manage lunch?
Hey, you. Food. Now, preferably.
nervous: Did they forget about us?
What if the food doesn't come?
Sorry, is there food today?
I get dizzy when I don't eat.
cheerful: Somebody say lunch? No? Oh well.
I could really go for a hot meal.
Food would be great whenever, crew!
Stomach's rumbling like a busted thruster.

any: I can't feel my stomach anymore.
Hey! Somebody bring food, we're dying in here.
I'd kill for a ration bar. Figure of speech.
They can't just starve us, can they?
I'm reporting this when I get out.
grumpy: This is a violation. I want to file a complaint.
You call this a paid contract? Feed us!
I'm chewing my own sleeve here.
I'll eat the bread. Even the old bread.
nervous: I don't feel good. At all.
Are they trying to starve us?
My hands are shaking.
Please, somebody, anything to eat.
cheerful: Okay, I'm officially not okay.
I'd hug whoever brings food.
Hungry enough to eat the book.
Crew? Buddies? Pals? Food, please?

any: This jumpsuit could stand up on its own.
I stink. I know I stink.
Could we get clean jumpsuits in here?
Hey, any chance of a fresh uniform?
I've been in this suit for days.
Don't sit near me. Trust me.
chatty: Hey, crew! Anyone got a clean jumpsuit? Asking for me.
I've smelled cargo holds cleaner than this suit.
Seriously, sniff test. No, don't.
I'm starting to smell like a salvage yard.
grumpy: This suit's disgusting. Get me a new one.
Who issued this rag? It's falling apart.
Smells like somebody died in it.
I'm not sleeping in this. Clean one. Now.
nervous: Is this a rash? Is it from the suit?
Sorry about the smell. It's not my fault.
Could I maybe get a clean jumpsuit? If it's no trouble?
I think this stain is spreading.
cheerful: I'm fragrant today. Very fragrant.
A fresh jumpsuit would be lovely, crew!
Laundry day would make my week.
Okay, even I can smell me now.

any: I think I need a medic.
Hey, crew! I'm hurt in here.
It hurts when I move my arm.
I'm bleeding. Little bit. Maybe a lot.
chatty: Hey, you! Got any bandages? I'm leaking.
Remind me not to do that again.
This'll make a good story. Once it stops hurting.
Anybody here know first aid? Anybody?
grumpy: Great. Just great. Now I'm hurt.
Medic! Or whatever you've got.
Somebody patch me up before I bleed on the floor.
This wing's a death trap.
nervous: Is it bad? Tell me it's not bad.
Oh no. Oh no, that's blood.
I need help. I really need help.
Please, somebody look at this.
cheerful: Just a scratch. A big scratch.
Ow! Okay, walked that one off. Mostly.
Could use a patch-up when you're free, crew!
I've had worse. Not much worse.

any: Can't see a thing in here.
grumpy: Brilliant. Now I can't read.
Who's paying for the lights, exactly?
Can't even see my own food.
Fix the lights already.
nervous: Something's moving. Is something moving?
Please turn the lights back on.
Who's there? Is that you?
I can hear breathing. Mine, probably.

any: What is that on the floor?
Crew could clean this place once in a while.
Smells like old rations in here.
My boots are sticking to the floor.
Hey, you! Grab a mop sometime.
grumpy: This place is a pigsty. Clean it.
Trash everywhere. Real professional.
I've seen cleaner engine rooms.
Somebody's getting a bad review.

any: Anybody hear the vents? I don't.
Somebody check the APC out there.
Doors won't work without power, right? Right?
Crew forgot to pay the power bill.
grumpy: Can't even keep the power on.
Great. Now what?
Somebody's getting fired for this.
Is anybody out there? Power's out!
nervous: If the air goes, we're done.
Is it getting colder? It's getting colder.
What if the doors open? Or don't?
I don't like this. I really don't.

any: Hey, you. Any chance of food?
Morning, officer. Or whatever you are.
Don't mind me. Just doing my time.
chatty: Hey, crew! How's the outpost doing?
You look busy. Want to hear a story?
Nice work on this place. The hoop's great.
What's the news out there? Anything happening?
Hey, how many ships came in today?
grumpy: Oh, look who finally showed up.
You're late with lunch.
Don't just stand there. Do something.
I've got complaints. A list of them.
nervous: Oh! Sorry. Didn't see you there.
I'm not doing anything, I swear.
Am I in trouble?
Um, hi. Is everything okay?
cheerful: Hey! Good to see a friendly face.
Hi there! Nice outpost you've got.
Crew's here! Everybody look busy.
Thanks for keeping the lights on.

chatty: Oh, you're a hero! What is this, anyway?
Thanks! Tell the cook they're a legend.
Food! I could hug you. I won't, but I could.
Thanks! Hey, any chance of seconds later?
grumpy: Took long enough. Thanks, I guess.
Better than nothing.
Is this the old bread again? Fine.
It's cold. But thanks.
nervous: Oh, thank you. Thank you so much.
Is this for me? Really?
Sorry to be a bother. Thanks.
Thanks. I was getting worried.
cheerful: Dinner's served! Thanks, crew!
You're the best. Seriously.
Oh, nice! This made my day.
Thanks! Compliments to whoever made it.

any: Smells like soap. I love it.
chatty: Look at me! Practically a new person.
Thanks! Now I'm the best dressed in here.
Oh, that's crisp. Thank you!
Smells like soap! Everybody come smell this.
grumpy: It's itchy. But it's clean. Thanks.
Wrong size. Whatever, thanks.
Took you long enough. Thanks.
Fine. Better than the old one.

any: Thanks. I thought I was done for.
Okay. I can move my arm again.
Thanks for not letting me bleed out.
grumpy: Took you long enough.
Hurts less. Thanks.
About time somebody helped.
Fine. Thanks. Still hurts.
nervous: Is it going to scar? Thanks, though.
Thank you. I really thought that was it.
Is it infected? It's not, right?
Thanks. Sorry for panicking.

any: I've had worse on long hauls.
Tastes like the tin it came in.
chatty: Anyone want to trade? I'll give you my crackers.
You know what this needs? Hot sauce.
Reminds me of my old ship's galley. Worse, though.
So what are we rating this? I say a four.
grumpy: This bread's older than me.
Who cooked this? Be honest.
Cold. Of course it's cold.
I'd send it back if I could.
cheerful: Hey, this isn't half bad!
Real food! What a day.
Compliments to the cook!
Saving the best bite for last.

chatty: You call that defense?
My grandma shoots better than you.
Loser cleans the table after dinner.
I'm open! I'm always open!
grumpy: Stop fouling me.
Give me the ball.
You're hogging it again.
Play properly or don't play.
Finally.
Took me long enough.
About time something went right.
Yeah, yeah. Lucky shot.
cheerful: Woo! Somebody write that down!
I'm on fire today!
Did everyone see that? Please say yes.
That one's for the crew!

grumpy: This ball's garbage.
Hoop's crooked. I'm telling you.
Stupid thing.
Who's laughing? Somebody's laughing.
cheerful: Oops! Next one's going in.
Well, the backboard enjoyed it.
Practice shot. Obviously.
Ha! Terrible. Again!

any: This book's missing the last page.
Somebody spilled coffee on chapter three.
I've read this one twice now.
The captain in this book is an idiot.
chatty: Hey, anyone read this one? The ending's wild.
You gotta read this after me.
Listen to this bit. No, really.
This writer hates pilots, I swear.

any: Nobody bother me for a bit.
Is the water always this warm?
Nice view. Wish I was out there.
Give me a shuttle and I'm gone.
Somebody's hauling a lot of cargo out there.
That looks like my old ship. It isn't.
Can't even tell what time it is.
Wonder if pirates ever hit this place.
chatty: Look at that one. Nice hull.
I used to fly something like that.
Bet that's a salvage crew. Look at the dents.
Somebody's having a better day than me.

grumpy: Nothing to do in here.
Bored out of my skull.
This place is too small.
Somebody give me a job.
nervous: What if they don't let me out?
Okay. Breathe. It's fine.
Something's wrong, I can feel it.
Why is nobody saying anything?

any: I heard something. Was that the hatch?
grumpy: Hurry up already.
How long does it take to open a hatch?
I'm gonna start banging on this thing.
Service in here is a joke.

any: How long are you keeping me in here?
I didn't do anything! Open up!
Hello? Anybody? I'm still locked in!
This is some real shitcurity right here.
I'm banging on this door till somebody comes.
You can't just bolt me in and walk off!
My legs are cramping. Let me out.
I want to talk to whoever's in charge.
Open this door or I swear...
Worst shitcurity on any outpost. I mean it.
That's it. I'm kicking this door till it opens.
chatty: Hey, crew! Funny joke. Now open the door.
Come on, let me out. I'll tell you a story.
Shitcurity! I'm telling every crew about this place!
Seriously, how long? Somebody give me a number.
grumpy: Open the damn door!
Shitcurity! Useless, the whole bunch of you!
I'm going to kick this door off its hinges.
Hell of a way to run a prison. Open up!
nervous: Please, I'll be good. Just open the door.
Did you forget about me? Please don't forget me.
It's getting hard to breathe in here. Please.
What did I do wrong? I'll fix it, I promise.
cheerful: Okay, joke's over! Open up, please!
Hey, crew? Door's stuck. Stuck on purpose, I bet.
Shitcurity! Ha. No, but seriously, open it.
I'm being patient! Mostly! Open up!

any: Nobody cares about us in here.
Food's late, lights are out. What's next?
Crew doesn't give a damn about us.
Somebody should do something about this.
If this keeps up, people are gonna snap.
I've had it with this wing.
chatty: You notice nobody's been by in ages?
I'm keeping a list of everything wrong here. It's long.
My last cell had better service than this.
grumpy: Worst-run wing I've ever been in.
I'm filing a complaint the second I'm out.
Can't even get a clean suit in this dump.
Every day it's something.
nervous: It's getting bad in here, isn't it?
People are getting angry. I don't like it.
Maybe if we ask nicely, they'll fix it.
cheerful: Okay, even I'm getting annoyed now.
Hard to stay positive in here today.
Come on, crew. Throw us a bone.

any: That's it. I'm done being patient.
Somebody's gonna get hurt in here.
They think we'll just sit here and take it?
Everybody up. We're not taking this.
Next crew member through that door gets it.
You hear me out there? We're done!
How much longer do we put up with this?
chatty: Listen up, everyone. We need to talk about this.
They can't lock all of us down at once.
I say we make some noise. Who's with me?
grumpy: I've had it. I'm breaking something.
They want trouble? They'll get trouble.
One more day of this and I swear.
nervous: Guys, calm down. Please.
This is getting out of hand.
I don't want any part of this. Do I?
cheerful: Even I'm fed up now. That's saying something.
Come on, crew. Don't make us do this.
Okay. No more nice prisoner.

any: You want a problem? Keep standing there.
chatty: Hey, pal. Personal space. Ever heard of it?
I'd back up if I were you. Just saying.
Keep crowding me and see how that goes.
grumpy: Get your hands off me or lose them.
Back off before I make you.
Touch me again and you'll regret it.
nervous: Please, just give me some room.
Don't come any closer. I mean it.
I'll fight back. I will.
cheerful: Whoa, easy there. Back it up.
Friendly advice? Step back.
Nobody needs to get hurt. Especially you.

any: This is for the gray soup!
Wreck it! Wreck all of it!
{other}, you want to go? Let's go.
Say that again, {other}. I dare you.
Touch my food again, {other}, and see what happens.
You took my bunk, {other}. Big mistake.
Keep talking, {other}. See where it gets you.
Remind me not to do that again.
Still got all my teeth. Good.
Anyone see where my shoe went?
Nobody talk to me for a bit.
Okay. Walked it off. Sort of.
Nice outpost! Mind if I look around?
Where's your hangar? Asking for a friend.
Which one of these ships is unlocked?
Anybody got a shuttle I can borrow?
I'll get out again. Just watch.
Watch the head! Watch the head!
Was I even gone that long?
Next time I'm taking the ball with me.
Good day. I represent a small research firm. Might I borrow an inmate?
A generous fee, for a single dose on one of your inmates.
Nothing permanent. Very likely nothing permanent.
Our compound needs a human subject. Yours are ideal.
Think of it as a donation to science. A paid one.
Just one injection. We'll handle the paperwork.
Your prisoners look healthy. Well fed. Perfect candidates.
I hear you run a tidy wing. Care to earn a little extra?
No questions asked, on either side. Shall we?
The inmate needn't know what's in it. Simpler that way.
Wonderful. Here's the injector. One dose is plenty.
Splendid. Inject it anywhere. The arm is traditional.
Thank you. Your payment's already on its way.
Excellent choice. Please don't drop it.
Here you are. Do stand back afterwards.
Marvelous. We'll be watching the results with interest.
Pleasure doing business. Mind the needle.
It's single use. Choose your inmate carefully.
Keep the receipt. Actually, better not.
Well. I'll be on my way.
A pity. Do call if you change your mind.
Good day. Give my regards to the inmates.
We'll be in touch. We always are.
No matter. There are other outposts.
Hey! What did you give me?
I don't feel right. At all.
My teeth feel weird. Is that normal?
WHAT DID YOU DO TO ME?!
WHERE'S THE ONE WITH THE NEEDLE?!
Bzzt. Why is everything so big?
Why do I want to eat the trash?
Why do I have so many eyes?
The rotten food smells amazing. That's bad, right?
I can see all of you at once. Bzz.
Something's wrong with my mouth. Bzzz.
Why am I rubbing my hands together?
Stay in the light! Stay in the light!
Get the crew! Something's killing us!
I saw it move. In the dark.
It's got someone! It's got someone!
I'm not going in there. No way.

conversations.opener: What are you in for, {other}?
This food is terrible.
replies: I've had worse on a salvage run.

conversations.opener: You think the crew's any good at this?
replies: They're new at it. You can tell.
Better than the last lot I had.

conversations.opener: Bet you can't hit a shot from the door.
replies: Bet you a dessert I can.
Don't need to. I've seen yours.

conversations.opener: Got a good book in there?
replies: It's a ship manual. So, no.
Half of one. Pages are missing.
You can have it when I'm done.

conversations.opener: First thing you're doing when you get out?
replies: Find my crew. If they waited.
Getting as far from here as my fuel allows.

conversations.opener: Heard pirates hit a trade outpost last week.
replies: Wasn't me. I was in here.

conversations.opener: {other}, did you take my blanket?
replies: Why would I want your blanket?

conversations.opener: What ship were you on?
replies: A freighter. Boring runs, good pay.
Little mining boat. I miss her.

conversations.opener: You ever been down on a planet?
replies: Once. Got eaten alive by bugs.
No. Ships and outposts, that's me.

conversations.opener: You snore, you know that?
How long have you got left?
replies: Long enough to beat you at hoops.

conversations.opener: Think they'll ever give us dessert?
Come on, {other}. What'd you really do?
replies: Nothing. They got the wrong person.
I'll tell you when we're out.

conversations.opener: I'm in for {crime}. You?
replies: Keep your voice down about it.

conversations.opener: Who do you think owns this outpost?
replies: Some crew with too many credits.

conversations.opener: Is it me, or is the bread stale?
Rematch. Right now.
You ever fly a shuttle?
replies: Crashed one once. Barely walked away.
Nah. I work the cargo bay.
Only for a few hours. It wasn't mine.

conversations.opener: Do you trust the crew here?
replies: Trust them? No. Like them? Sure.

conversations.opener: My old captain would've paid my bail.
replies: Mine sold my bunk before I was cuffed.
Captains don't pay bail. Nobody does.

conversations.opener: Did you hear that noise last night?
Heard some crew found a derelict full of gold.
replies: Heard it was full of pirates.
Nobody finds gold. They find scrap.
Every week there's a rumour like that.

conversations.opener: What's the worst job you ever had?
replies: Deckhand on a pirate tug. Unpaid.

conversations.opener: You want the last ration bar?
These jumpsuits are awful.
replies: Mine smells like whoever wore it last.
Complain to the crew. They love that.

conversations.opener: {other}, you cheat at cards.
What's the book about?
replies: A pilot who gets lost. Again.
Not sure. I keep falling asleep.
A murder on a freighter. It's good.

conversations.opener: Crew's late with food again.
replies: They're busy. Ships to fix, probably.
Complain and I'll eat your share.

conversations.opener: You think they'll ever fix the lights?
replies: Put in a request. See what happens.

conversations.opener: Where you headed after this?
replies: Back to salvage. It's all I know.

conversations.opener: I could take you one on one.
replies: You couldn't take me with a ladder.

conversations.opener: Ever meet a real pirate?
replies: Met a few. Most are just broke.
Who says I haven't been one?

conversations.opener: I miss my bunk on the ship.
replies: At least this one doesn't shake.
I miss mine too. Kind of.
Ship bunks are worse than this.

conversations.opener: How'd they catch you, {other}?
replies: Customs scan. Never saw it coming.
My own crew turned me in.
Got drunk and bragged about it.

conversations.opener: Tell me a joke.
replies: I don't know any clean ones.

conversations.opener: Why is the soup always gray?
replies: Don't ask questions you don't want answered.
It's supposed to be gray. I think.
Eat it before it gets grayer.

conversations.opener: You sleeping okay in here?
replies: Like a rock. A cold rock.

conversations.opener: Know anyone who can get us out early?
replies: No. And keep your voice down.
If I did, I'd be gone.
Just do the time. It's short.

conversations.opener: Somebody left a mess at the table.
Did you see that ship dock earlier?
replies: Probably dropping off more of us.

conversations.opener: Want to play something?
Customs is getting tougher out there.
replies: Tell me about it. Look where I am.
Only if you're dumb enough to get stopped.
That's why I quit smuggling. Mostly.

conversations.opener: What's the first meal you'd order out there?
replies: Real steak. Not the vat kind.

conversations.opener: Think we get time off for good behavior?
Do you ever miss your crew?
replies: Ask me again if they come get me.

conversations.opener: Who keeps stealing the basketball?
{other}, you look terrible.
Ever been to one of the big trade outposts?
replies: Once. Spent all my credits in an hour.

conversations.opener: It's quieter in here than on my ship.
The crew here's alright, you know.
replies: They're fine when they show up.
Don't let them hear you say that.

conversations.opener: Somebody locked me in yesterday. Real shitcurity.
replies: What'd you do to deserve it?
